name: Umbral Recall
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shadow class, Shadowcraft class feature, character level 8th

Benefit(s): You can store information within shadowy constructs. Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes creating a shadow construct that contains information you’ve learned (up to 1 page of text or 5 minutes of speech). You can recall this information perfectly at any time by spending a standard action to interact with the construct. The construct lasts for 24 hours or until you create a new one.

Only you can see and interact with this construct, and it follows you, always staying within 5 feet of your position.
